description: Use this when the user needs an existing sound effect or a piece of background music — for a video, podcast, stream, game, app or presentation — rather than a newly generated one. Searches BudgetPixel's free audio library, licensed CC BY 4.0 for commercial use, every item listened to and scored before listing. kind "sound_effect": whooshes, impacts, UI sounds, Foley, ambiences, animals, vehicles (a fraction of a second to about 6 s). kind "music": instrumental background tracks such as lofi, corporate, cinematic, acoustic (up to about a minute). Costs 10 credits per search, charged even when nothing matches. Try it before generate_sound_effect or generate_music: a search is cheaper and instant. Write the query as a few plain words naming the sound ("door creak", "soft notification chime", "lofi study beat"), not a generation prompt: every word counts, and a word the library does not have counts as a miss. It never generates: if nothing fits, say so. LICENCE: wherever a result is used, include its credit line exactly as returned (the `attribution` text; `attribution_html` for web pages).

category.description: Optional category filter. Sound effects only; music has no categories.

kind.description: Which library: "sound_effect" (whooshes, impacts, UI sounds, Foley, ambiences) or "music" (instrumental background tracks).

limit.description: How many results to return (default 10, max 20). The price is the same for any limit.

max_duration.description: Optional: longest result, in seconds (e.g. 1 for one-shot sound effects).

min_duration.description: Optional: shortest result, in seconds (e.g. 30 for a music bed of at least half a minute).

offset.description: For the next page: the previous offset plus the number returned. Each page is a new 10-credit search.

query.description: The sound, in a few plain words — e.g. "door creak", "soft notification chime", "rain on a tin roof"; for music the genre, mood or use — "lofi study", "upbeat corporate", "dark true crime documentary". Max 200 characters. Name the sound itself; leave out lengths and production notes. Optional only when browsing a sound-effect category.

sort.description: popular (default — best matches first when there is a query), newest, or top (highest rated).

name: search_stock_audio
title: Search Stock Sound Effects & Music
